info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get External Agency By Param1-spec
info.description: The External Agency Retrieval API enables users to retrieve specific external agency details based on a unique parameter. This endpoint is particularly useful for banking institutions and financial organizations needing to access contractual agreements associated with sub-custodian agencies. By providing a parameter value, consumers can obtain relevant data to facilitate compliance and operational processing. Typical use cases include audits, compliance checks, and information retrieval for transaction processing.

get.summary: Retrieve Sub Custodian Agreement by ID
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of a specific Sub Custodian Agreement using its unique identifier. The response will include all relevant information related to the agreement, ensuring quick access to necessary data for your operational needs.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the sub-custodian agreement details for the specified resource identifier. It should include any necessary parameters to filter or specify the request according to the needs of the operation.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the sub-custodian agreement details.

GetExternalAgencyByParam1Request.description: A JSON representation of the request body for the sub-custodian agreement operation.

institutionId.description: The unique identifier for the institution involved in the agreement.

agreementId.description: The unique identifier for the agreement.

bic.description: The Bank Identifier Code (BIC) for the financial institution.

countryCode.description: The ISO country code where the institution is located.

effectiveDate.description: The date when the agreement becomes effective, in ISO 8601 format.

recordStatus.description: The status of the record indicating if it is active, inactive, etc.

version.description: The version number of the agreement.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when the agreement was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

correlationId.description: ID used to trace a request across multiple services.

generatedAt.description: The timestamp when the response was generated, in ISO 8601 format.

processingRegion.description: Region where the request was processed.

metadata.description: Metadata related to the response, useful for tracing and logging.

GetExternalAgencyByParam1Response_200.description: Schema representing the response for retrieving sub-custodian agreement details from an external agency.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: Unique identifier for the endpoint that was invoked, facilitating traceability and auditing of requests.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name of the application or service that processed the request, useful for monitoring and troubleshooting purposes.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses Bearer authentication with JWT (JSON Web Tokens). The client must provide a valid JWT token in the Authorization header of the request to access protected resources.
